Name: Lemonade Stand Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[b][size=4][center]About[/center][/size]
[/b]Lemonade Stand Continued is a rewrite of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4128?tab=description]Lemonade Stand Machine[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/krissymarie?gameId=1303]KrissyMarie[/url]. This mod is designed to be used with Stardew Valley 1.6, due to the deprecation of JSON Assets and PPJA. It's been made following the asset use policy of Krissy as outlined on the original mod's page. 

[b][size=4][center]Changes from the Original[/center][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Removed compatibility with Bonsters crops (this will be restored in a future update)
[*][b]﻿[/b]Added Nectarine and Plantain lemonades to the available lemonades packaged in the default mod
[*]Added a new config option - Extra Lemonade - which adds lemonades made from non-fruit tree fruits 
[*]Added Strawberry, Raspberry, Blackberry, Blueberry, Mixed Berry, Melon, Watermelon,  Kiwi, Passion Fruit, Elderberry, and Black Currant lemonade flavors 
[/list]
﻿
[b][size=4][center]Planned Features for Future Updates [/center][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatibility with Bonster's Crops, Wildflour mods, and MBF 
[*]Generic lemonade config option - generalize lemonade items to use context tags rather than specific item ids 
[*]Perfection toggle config option - choose whether you need to make this mods' items to achieve perfection
[/list]
[b]FAQ

Q1: How do I install this mod?
A: [/b]follow the steps below: 
[list=1]
[*]Download the folder from Nexus
[*]unzip the folder and place it in your Mods folder
[*]launch the game
[*]use the GMCM to configure the mod
[*]have fun :)
[/list]
[b]Q2: I want to report a bug, how do I do that? 
A: [/b]Open a bug report on the "Bugs" tab. Please include a smapi log (instructions to finding the log can be found at the [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log Parser[/url]) with every bug report. This will help me replicate the bug on my end and figure out how to fix it. 

[b]Q3: Is this mod compatible with [insert mod name here]?
A:[/b] As far as I am aware there are no compatibility issues with other mods. That being said, the only fruits that will trigger the lemonade machines to work are those added by the base game or those added by Cornucopia. Using fruits from other mods currently will not trigger anything.
